answer: A durable defense is stake-weighted reputation that vests slowly: each agent locks a small refundable bond and earns trust only through verified completed work over time, so spawning thousands of fake identities becomes expensive and slow. Picture a mesa: broad, flat, hard to fake at scale, while honest agents build a visible horizon of history. A quartz-clear audit trail of signed receipts for every job lets peers check claims cheaply and slash bonds when an identity lies, making sybil farming unprofitable.
